surahContext.Ar-Ra'd: Surah Ar-Ra'd · 'The Thunder' · Meccan; on certainty in the unseen and the steadiness of remembrance.
surahContext.Az-Zumar: Surah Az-Zumar · 'The Throngs' · Meccan; despair-not, and the door of mercy is wider than wrong.
surahContext.At-Talaaq: Surah At-Talaaq · 'Divorce' · Medinan; on tawakkul and provision arriving from unseen quarters.
surahContext.Ash-Sharh: Surah Ash-Sharh · 'The Relief' · Meccan; with hardship, ease — twice promised in three lines.
surahContext.Al-Baqara: Surah Al-Baqara · 'The Cow' · Medinan, the Qur'an's longest chapter; closes on a prayer for forgiveness and aid.
surahContext.Aal-i-Imraan: Surah Aal-i-Imraan · 'Family of Imran' · Medinan; courage in a fragile season.
surahContext.Al-Anfaal: Surah Al-Anfaal · 'The Spoils' · Medinan; obedience, unity, and patience as a discipline.
surahContext.Quran: From the Holy Qur'an · revealed to Muhammad ﷺ over 23 years (610–632 CE).

quoteLibrary.text: We suffer from an incurable malady: hope.
quoteLibrary.author: Mahmoud Darwish

quoteLibrary.text: Think of others, not only the absent ones.
quoteLibrary.author: Mahmoud Darwish

quoteLibrary.text: You can cut all the flowers but you cannot keep spring from coming.
quoteLibrary.author: Pablo Neruda

quoteLibrary.text: Raise your words, not voice. It is rain that grows flowers, not thunder.
quoteLibrary.author: Rumi (tr.)

quoteLibrary.text: Out beyond ideas of wrongdoing and rightdoing there is a field. I will meet you there.
quoteLibrary.author: Rumi (tr.)

quoteLibrary.text: Speak, for your lips are yet free.
quoteLibrary.author: Faiz Ahmed Faiz (tr.)

quoteLibrary.text: This is not that dawn, that longing for which we had hoped.
quoteLibrary.author: Faiz Ahmed Faiz (tr.)

quoteLibrary.text: Identity is what we say we are, and what others think we are.
quoteLibrary.author: Edward Said

quoteLibrary.text: Exile is strangely compelling to think about but terrible to experience.
quoteLibrary.author: Edward Said

quoteLibrary.text: Not everything that is faced can be changed, but nothing can be changed until it is faced.
quoteLibrary.author: James Baldwin

quoteLibrary.text: The classroom remains the most radical space of possibility in the academy.
quoteLibrary.author: bell hooks

quoteLibrary.text: Until the lions have their historians, tales of hunting will always glorify the hunter.
quoteLibrary.author: Chinua Achebe

quoteLibrary.text: The minute we choose to love we begin to move against domination.
quoteLibrary.author: bell hooks

quoteLibrary.text: They tried to bury us. They did not know we were seeds.
quoteLibrary.author: Dinos Christianopoulos

quoteLibrary.text: We teach life, sir.
quoteLibrary.author: Rafeef Ziadah

quoteLibrary.ur: دل میں بس اک تمنائی ہے
quoteLibrary.ro: Dil mein bas ek tamanna hai
quoteLibrary.en: Only one longing remains in the heart.

quoteLibrary.ur: آئینے کی شام میں بس تم
quoteLibrary.ro: Aaine ki shaam mein bas tum
quoteLibrary.en: In the mirror's evening, only you.

quoteLibrary.ur: خدی کو کر بلند اتنا کہ ہر تقدیر سے پہلے
quoteLibrary.ro: Khudi ko kar buland itna ke har taqdeer se pehle
quoteLibrary.en: Raise the self so high that, before every fate, God Himself asks: tell Me, what would you have?

quoteLibrary.ur: شام ہوتی ہے، سحر ہوتی ہے، یہ بہار ہوتی ہے
quoteLibrary.ro: Shaam hoti hai, sehr hoti hai, ye bahaar hoti hai
quoteLibrary.en: Evenings come, dawns come, and this is what spring is.

quoteLibrary.text: Hope is the thing with feathers that perches in the soul.
quoteLibrary.author: Emily Dickinson

quoteLibrary.text: I dwell in possibility.
quoteLibrary.author: Emily Dickinson

quoteLibrary.text: There is no charm equal to tenderness of heart.
quoteLibrary.author: Jane Austen

quoteLibrary.text: Faith is the bird that feels the light and sings when the dawn is still dark.
quoteLibrary.author: Rabindranath Tagore

quoteLibrary.text: If winter comes, can spring be far behind?
quoteLibrary.author: Percy Bysshe Shelley

quoteLibrary.text: Go confidently in the direction of your dreams. Live the life you have imagined.
quoteLibrary.author: Henry David Thoreau

quoteLibrary.text: Patience is also a form of action.
quoteLibrary.author: Auguste Rodin

quoteLibrary.text: What are men to rocks and mountains?
quoteLibrary.author: Jane Austen

quoteLibrary.text: The quieter the room, the more clearly the heart can hear itself.
quoteLibrary.author: Editorial Library

quoteLibrary.text: A steady heart can outlast a loud storm.
quoteLibrary.author: Editorial Library

quoteLibrary.text: Light returns first to the horizon, then to the room.
quoteLibrary.author: Editorial Library

quoteLibrary.text: Quiet effort carries farther than hurried noise.
quoteLibrary.author: Editorial Library

quoteLibrary.text: The sky makes room for every honest beginning.
quoteLibrary.author: Editorial Library

quoteLibrary.text: Mercy often arrives before certainty does.
quoteLibrary.author: Editorial Library

quoteLibrary.text: Some mornings are built for gratitude before language.
quoteLibrary.author: Editorial Library

quoteLibrary.text: Even worn hands can carry tomorrow with dignity.
quoteLibrary.author: Editorial Library

quoteLibrary.text: A kind word can open a locked morning.
quoteLibrary.author: Editorial Library

quoteLibrary.text: The road grows clearer to those who keep walking.
quoteLibrary.author: Editorial Library

quoteLibrary.text: The horizon teaches patience by never hurrying toward us.
quoteLibrary.author: Editorial Library

quoteLibrary.text: Silence is not emptiness; it is a room still filling with meaning.
quoteLibrary.author: Editorial Library

quoteLibrary.text: What bends with grace often survives with grace.
quoteLibrary.author: Editorial Library

quoteLibrary.text: Spring begins as a rumor and becomes a landscape.
quoteLibrary.author: Editorial Library

quoteLibrary.text: Reverence is a kind of listening that steadies the whole body.
quoteLibrary.author: Editorial Library

quoteLibrary.text: The smallest honest task can restore an entire day.
quoteLibrary.author: Editorial Library

quoteLibrary.text: Every open window reminds the room that there is more world outside.
quoteLibrary.author: Editorial Library

quoteLibrary.text: Not every answer arrives loudly; some of them arrive clear.
quoteLibrary.author: Editorial Library

quoteLibrary.text: Hope is often built from ordinary acts repeated with courage.
quoteLibrary.author: Editorial Library

quoteLibrary.text: Dawn keeps its promise by returning one color at a time.
quoteLibrary.author: Editorial Library

quoteLibrary.text: A calm breath can become its own kind of prayer.
quoteLibrary.author: Editorial Library

quoteLibrary.text: What you seek is seeking you.
quoteLibrary.author: Rumi

quoteLibrary.text: Yesterday I was clever, so I wanted to change the world. Today I am wise, so I am changing myself.
quoteLibrary.author: Rumi

quoteLibrary.text: The wound is the place where the Light enters you.
quoteLibrary.author: Rumi

quoteLibrary.text: Knowledge without action is wastefulness and action without knowledge is foolishness.
quoteLibrary.author: Imam Al-Ghazali

quoteLibrary.text: He who knows himself knows his Lord.
quoteLibrary.author: Ibn Arabi

quoteLibrary.text: Perplexity is the beginning of knowledge.
quoteLibrary.author: Khalil Gibran

quoteLibrary.text: Generosity is giving more than you can, and pride is taking less than you need.
quoteLibrary.author: Khalil Gibran

quoteLibrary.text: You have power over your mind — not outside events. Realize this, and you will find strength.
quoteLibrary.author: Marcus Aurelius

quoteLibrary.text: Tell me, what is it you plan to do with your one wild and precious life?
quoteLibrary.author: Mary Oliver

quoteLibrary.ur: ستاروں سے آگے جہاں اور بھی ہیں، ابھی عشق کے امتحاں اور بھی ہیں
quoteLibrary.ro: Sitaron se aage jahan aur bhi hain, abhi ishq ke imtihan aur bhi hain
quoteLibrary.en: Beyond the stars there are still other worlds; there are still other trials of love to come.

quoteLibrary.ur: ہزاروں خواہشیں ایسی کہ ہر خواہش پہ دم نکلے
quoteLibrary.ro: Hazaron khwahishein aisi ke har khwahish pe dam nikle
quoteLibrary.en: Thousands of desires, each worth dying for — many were fulfilled, yet still too few.

quoteLibrary.ur: تندیٔ بادِ مخالف سے نہ گھبرا اے عقاب، یہ تو چلتی ہے تجھے اونچا اڑانے کے لیے
quoteLibrary.ro: Tundi-e-baad-e-mukhalif se na ghabra ae uqaab, yeh to chalti hai tujhe ooncha urane ke liye
quoteLibrary.en: Do not fear the fierce headwind, O eagle — it blows only to lift you higher.

ayahFallbacks.text: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَطْمَئِنُّ قُلُوبُهُم بِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ أَلَا بِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ تَطْمَئِنُّ ٱلْقُلُوبُ
ayahFallbacks.translation: Those who believe, and whose hearts find rest in the remembrance of Allah. Verily, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.

ayahFallbacks.text: ۞ قُلْ يَٰعِبَادِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَا تَقْنَطُوا۟ مِن رَّحْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَغْفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًا ۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahFallbacks.translation: Say: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, despair not of the mercy of Allah. Indeed, Allah forgives all sins. Indeed, He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.

ayahFallbacks.text: وَيَرْزُقْهُ مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَحْتَسِبُ ۚ وَمَن يَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَهُوَ حَسْبُهُۥٓ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَٰلِغُ أَمْرِهِۦ ۚ قَدْ جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ لِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدْرًا
ayahFallbacks.translation: And He will provide for him from where he does not expect. And whoever relies upon Allah — then He is sufficient for him.

ayahFallbacks.text: فَإِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
ayahFallbacks.translation: For indeed, with hardship comes ease.

ayahFallbacks.text: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلْعُسْرِ يُسْرًا
ayahFallbacks.translation: Indeed, with hardship comes ease.

ayahFallbacks.text: لَا يُكَلِّفُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسًا إِلَّا وُسْعَهَا
ayahFallbacks.translation: Allah does not burden a soul beyond that it can bear.

ayahFallbacks.text: وَلَا تَهِنُوا۟ وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا۟ وَأَنتُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَوْنَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
ayahFallbacks.translation: Do not weaken and do not grieve, and you will be superior if you are true believers.

ayahFallbacks.text: وَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
ayahFallbacks.translation: And be patient and steadfast; indeed, Allah is with the patient.

ayahFallbacks.text: فَٱذْكُرُونِىٓ أَذْكُرْكُمْ وَٱشْكُرُوا۟ لِى وَلَا تَكْفُرُونِ
ayahFallbacks.translation: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.

ayahFallbacks.text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱسْتَعِينُوا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَٱلصَّلَوٰةِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلصَّٰبِرِينَ
ayahFallbacks.translation: O you who have believed, seek help through patience and prayer. Indeed, Allah is with the patient.

ayahFallbacks.text: وَإِذَا سَأَلَكَ عِبَادِى عَنِّى فَإِنِّى قَرِيبٌ ۖ أُجِيبُ دَعْوَةَ ٱلدَّاعِ إِذَا دَعَانِ
ayahFallbacks.translation: And when My servants ask you concerning Me — indeed I am near. I respond to the invocation of the supplicant when he calls upon Me.

ayahFallbacks.text: حَسْبُنَا ٱللَّهُ وَنِعْمَ ٱلْوَكِيلُ
ayahFallbacks.translation: Sufficient for us is Allah, and He is the best Disposer of affairs.

ayahFallbacks.text: لَئِن شَكَرْتُمْ لَأَزِيدَنَّكُمْ
ayahFallbacks.translation: If you are grateful, I will surely increase you in favor.

ayahFallbacks.text: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحًا مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَنُحْيِيَنَّهُۥ حَيَوٰةً طَيِّبَةً
ayahFallbacks.translation: Whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while a believer — We will surely cause them to live a good and pure life.

ayahFallbacks.text: رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً وَهَيِّئْ لَنَا مِنْ أَمْرِنَا رَشَدًا
ayahFallbacks.translation: Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.

ayahFallbacks.text: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱشْرَحْ لِى صَدْرِى وَيَسِّرْ لِىٓ أَمْرِى
ayahFallbacks.translation: My Lord, expand for me my breast with peace, and ease for me my task.

ayahFallbacks.text: وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدْنِى عِلْمًا
ayahFallbacks.translation: And say: My Lord, increase me in knowledge.

ayahFallbacks.text: لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنتَ سُبْحَٰنَكَ إِنِّى كُنتُ مِنَ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
ayahFallbacks.translation: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.

ayahFallbacks.text: ٱللَّهُ نُورُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ
ayahFallbacks.translation: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth.

ayahFallbacks.text: وَعِبَادُ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ هَوْنًا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ ٱلْجَٰهِلُونَ قَالُوا۟ سَلَٰمًا
ayahFallbacks.translation: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily, and when the ignorant address them harshly, they say words of peace.

ayahFallbacks.text: رَبِّ إِنِّى لِمَآ أَنزَلْتَ إِلَىَّ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَقِيرٌ
ayahFallbacks.translation: My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need.

ayahFallbacks.text: وَٱلَّذِينَ جَٰهَدُوا۟ فِينَا لَنَهْدِيَنَّهُمْ سُبُلَنَا ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَمَعَ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
ayahFallbacks.translation: And those who strive for Us — We will surely guide them to Our ways. And indeed, Allah is with the doers of good.

ayahFallbacks.text: وَمِنْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦٓ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا لِّتَسْكُنُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُم مَّوَدَّةً وَرَحْمَةً
ayahFallbacks.translation: And of His signs is that He created for you from yourselves mates that you may find tranquility in them; and He placed between you affection and mercy.

ayahFallbacks.text: وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ٱدْعُونِىٓ أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ
ayahFallbacks.translation: And your Lord says: Call upon Me; I will respond to you.

ayahFallbacks.text: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ
ayahFallbacks.translation: And We are closer to him than his jugular vein.

ayahFallbacks.text: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
ayahFallbacks.translation: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

ayahFallbacks.text: هَلْ جَزَآءُ ٱلْإِحْسَٰنِ إِلَّا ٱلْإِحْسَٰنُ
ayahFallbacks.translation: Is the reward for goodness anything but goodness?

ayahFallbacks.text: وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
ayahFallbacks.translation: And He is with you wherever you are. And Allah is Seeing of what you do.

ayahFallbacks.text: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
ayahFallbacks.translation: Allah — there is no deity except Him. And upon Allah let the believers rely.

ayahFallbacks.text: مَا وَدَّعَكَ رَبُّكَ وَمَا قَلَىٰ
ayahFallbacks.translation: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, nor has He detested you.

ayahFallbacks.text: وَلَسَوْفَ يُعْطِيكَ رَبُّكَ فَتَرْضَىٰٓ
ayahFallbacks.translation: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
